answer_1.quote: Knowledge base question answering (KBQA) is an increasingly significant research area that leverages structured knowledge bases (KBs) to provide precise answers to natural language (NL) questions.

answer_2.quote: SP-based methods generate logical forms, which consequently produce answers in an unordered manner. These should be evaluated using the F1 score. Additionally, we also report the Random Hits@1 (RHits@1), and the Exact Match (EM) metric for reference.
